import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
repo=pathlib.Path('/Users/b.k./Desktop/hSUM');sys.path.insert(0,str(repo))
from benches.retrieval_scale.harness import command_environment,readiness_probe_arguments
from benches.retrieval_stress.harness import run_cancel_storm,load_manifest
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/b.k./.cache/hsum-qualification/2026-10-21-WkRefX')
binary=repo/'target/release/hsum'
reference=json.loads((repo/'eval/results/vector-source-2026-10-23-macos-diagnostic.json').read_text())
report={'qualification':False,'purpose':'Real-model runtime controls after Tokio 1.53.0 to 1.53.3 patch; comparisons use recorded b01a3a6 results.','source_commit_before_patch':'b01a3a6e8d90bb1c2fa616b1843d23adf2f05024','binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cargo_toml_sha256':hashlib.sha256((repo/'Cargo.toml').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cargo_lock_sha256':hashlib.sha256((repo/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'controls':[]}
for mode in ['lexical','semantic','hybrid']:
 argv=readiness_probe_arguments(binary,'duplicate bounded evidence archive',mode)+['--explain']
 result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root/'cancel-smoke',env=command_environment(root/'home'),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=40)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
 packet=json.loads(result.stdout)
 previous=next(r['packet'] for r in reference['cli_controls']['observations'] if r['mode']==mode and r['condition']=='after')
 def identities(packet):return [(r['citation_uri'],r['score'],r['content_sha256']) for r in packet['results']]
 assert identities(packet)==identities(previous)
 for row in packet['results']:
  assert row['source_uri']=='repo://evidence.md'
  body=(root/'cancel-smoke/evidence.md').read_bytes();span=row['span'];content=row['content'].encode()
  assert body[span['start_byte']:span['end_byte']]==content
  assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()==row['content_sha256']
 report['controls'].append({'mode':mode,'argv':argv,'packet':packet,'stderr':result.stderr})
 print(mode,'matches',len(packet['results']),'verified passages',flush=True)
report['cancel_storm']=run_cancel_storm(binary,root/'cancel-smoke',root/'home',load_manifest())
report['validation']={'cargo_deny_all_features_check':'passed','cargo_xtask_check':'passed','release_smoke':'passed'}
report['probe_source']=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
(repo/'eval/results/tokio-1.53.3-2026-10-23-macos.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report['cancel_storm']),flush=True)
